description: Implementation of ProductAttributeService, managing product attribute operations including retrieval and update functionalities within the shopizer e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ProductAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing product attributes, extending generic sales manager entity service, annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: ProductAttributeServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor injecting ProductAttributeDao and passing it to superclass.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a product attribute by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes associated with a specific option ID within a store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves product attributes by a list of attribute IDs within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves product attributes associated with a specific option value ID within a store.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Fetches all product attributes linked to a specific product in a store for a given language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new or updates an existing product attribute.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product attribute, fetching it first to handle detached instances.
